title: Galaxy Formation through Filamentary Accretion at z = 6.1
question: What is the detailed spatial and kinematic structure of [C II] and dust emission in the z=6.07 LBG WMH5, and does it indicate galaxy assembly via accretion of satellites along a filament?

data.sensitivity: continuum 9 uJy/beam; line cube 0.1 mJy/beam per 17 km/s channel

what.value: Cycle 2 ALMA observations of WMH5 combined with Cycle 3 data

evidence.quote: we combined these data with the Cycle 2 observations of (cite: will15).

what.value: SFR_SED and SFR_FIR summed to total SFR 76+-11 Msun/yr

evidence.quote: we add SFR$_{SED}$ and SFR$_{FIR}$ of (cite: will15), yielding $76\pm11$ M$_{\odot}$ year$^{-1}$.

what.value: [CII]/continuum ratios of z~5.5 galaxies HZ4, HZ6, HZ9, HZ10

evidence.quote: These four give ratios of $(6\pm2)\times10^3$ km s$^{-1}$ (HZ4)[^2]

recipe.goal: Combine and reweight Cycle 2 and 3 data, image
recipe.method: Reweight uv data with statwt, then clean with natural weighting to make continuum image and [CII] cube

recipe.goal: Fit spectra of core and tail components
recipe.method: 1D Gaussian fits to single-pixel spectra at core and tail positions
2D Gaussian fits to moment-0 maps of core and sub-galaxy velocity ranges; SFR from Vallini et al. eq. 8
key_parameters: core 169 to -77 km/s; sub-galaxies -94 to -305 km/s

recipe.method: Ratio of line to continuum surface brightness at core and tail; L_CII via Solomon+92 eq.1; FIR from greybody
assumptions: T_dust=30 K, beta=1.6, FIR 42.5-122.5 um, uniform across source

recipe.method: Bianchi 2013 eq. 1 with 160 um flux density
assumptions: kappa0=1.88 m2/kg at 2.4 THz; T=25-100 K, beta=1.2-2.0 range

evidence.quote: a velocity integrated flux density of $0.32\pm0.03$ Jy km s$^{-1}$
The line to continuum ratio for the core is then: $(4.3\pm0.8)\times10^3$ km s$^{-1}$.
we find a dust mass of $(4.0\pm0.8)\times10^8\,M_{\odot}$

not_stated_but_needed: Cell size, image size, clean threshold and masks
Continuum/line channel selection and continuum subtraction method
Flux calibrators and CASA version used for Cycle 3
Velocity ranges and fitting details for Gaussian fits; exact Cycle 2 data processing
Metallicity-SFR calculation details from Vallini eq. 8
missing_for_reproduction: Spectral extraction details and velocity ranges for fits
score_reason: Data public and main steps described, but imaging details missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results from Gaussian fits and simple derived quantities; some imaging choices unstated.
